subject: Legacy portal bridge: MSA redlines + order-form/PO field mapping
messages:
From: Sara Hansen <sara.hansen@medicore.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + MSA redlines for legacy Coupa -> Ariba bridge

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. We are finishing procurement preparation for a migration project and need Redwood to accept POs coming from our legacy Coupa instance (some upstream teams still send the older PO XML). Two asks from our side: 

1) Do you have an MSA redline workflow we can use? We attached the PO spec you asked for (MediCore_PO_spec.pdf) — it shows the legacy fields we expect (invoiceReceiver, buyerTaxCode, legacyPORef).
2) We need help mapping those fields into your order form so our PO validator doesn't reject small-value POs during the migration. If you can confirm which fields are required vs optional on your side, we can map on our end.

Timing: procurement would like to complete registration and mapping the week of July 26 so the migration cutover stays on schedule. Can we get a quick list of what Redwood needs (legal redlines, order-form changes, PO schema mapping)?

Thanks — attached is the example PO and a short sample XML.

Sara Hansen
Sr. Procurement Manager
MediCore Health
Attachments: MediCore_PO_spec.pdf (PDF), sample_po.xml (XML stub)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hansen <sara.hansen@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + MSA redlines for legacy Coupa -> Ariba bridge

Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the sample XML. I pulled legal & procurement into thread to speed coordination.

Immediate plan: 
- Ben — can you confirm whether the legacy fields (invoiceReceiver, buyerTaxCode, legacyPORef) are mappable to our Order Form today or if we need a nuisance-field flag?
- Grace — can Legal start a targeted redline of the MSA for mediation of third-party PO format acceptance and indemnity language tied to file format validation? We may need a short addendum rather than full MSA swap.

I've attached our vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf to capture the usual gating items (tax forms, W9, EDI/PO mapping). Once we have Ben's mapping list + Grace's redline estimate I will propose a go/no-go timeline for the July 26 window.

Connor O'Brien
Partner Success — Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sara Hansen <sara.hansen@medicore.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + MSA redlines for legacy Coupa -> Ariba bridge

Connor / team — looked through the sample and flagged the key gaps. High-level notes: 

- invoiceReceiver -> maps to our billing.contact.email (optional in form; we can make it recommended during onboarding)
- buyerTaxCode -> we currently store taxCode at account level; we can accept per-PO tax overrides but need a short validation rule to prevent invalid codes (proposal: pattern-check + fallback to account-level taxCode)
- legacyPORef -> we can accept as externalReference field (need to add to Order Form v2 schema)

Attachments: created a quick PO field mapping sheet and pushed to SUP-4827 (see link). I also started a DocuSign envelope for MSA v3 redlines for faster circulation: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ — placeholder until Legal finalizes.

Questions for Sara: can MediCore provide a list of <invoiceReceiver> permutations you see in production? If there are multiple shapes (email vs numeric ID) it will affect validation rules.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference
From: Sara Hansen <sara.hansen@medicore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + MSA redlines for legacy Coupa -> Ariba bridge

Ben — thanks, this is exactly the sort of mapping note we needed. Attached is a small sample set showing invoiceReceiver as either an email address (most common) or a numeric ID (we've seen both): sample_po_snippets.xml.

We can standardize to sending an email address but our ERP team wants the migration to accept both for at least 30 days. If you can accept the email pattern and numeric fallback for that provisional period, that would be ideal.

Also — small ask: will Redwood's portal require a separate EDI setup or will the Order Form change be sufficient for our initial cutover? If EDI needed we should push this to the August window.

Sara
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hansen <sara.hansen@medicore.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + MSA redlines for legacy Coupa -> Ariba bridge

Sara / team — thanks for the sample. Legal reviewed the high-level ask and recommends the following immediate steps to keep the July 26 cutover achievable: 

1) Formalize a short addendum to MSA (MSA_v3_redlines) that explicitly permits acceptance of legacy PO schemas during the migration window and limits liability to validation failures where Redwood follows the agreed mapping rules. Draft attached: Redlines_MSA_v3.docx.
2) Ben / Onboarding — implement the Order Form v2 change to include externalReference and invoiceReceiver (accepts email OR numeric id for a 30-day grace period); I asked for a mapping spreadsheet and added PO_schema_mapping.xlsx to the attachments.
3) We do NOT require full EDI for the initial cutover; the order-form change + a transient validation exception is sufficient, but we will revisit for production stability.

Please confirm acceptance of the addendum and I'll route MSA_v3 for signature via DocuSign (link above). If accepted, Ben: please schedule the portal change to a non-prod deploy by July 22 and a production deploy on July 25 (night window). Connor: once you confirm timeline to MediCore I'll block time for a short alignment call (30 min) the week of July 19.

Grace O'Connor
Legal Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redlines_MSA_v3.docx, PO_schema_mapping.xlsx
